release_scope: Deploy current main with the follow-up live IFFCO scanned-policy OCR extraction hardening. It preserves review-required behavior when CPA cannot be read reliably.

The parser change is narrowly scoped to IFFCO scanned OCR anchors and reconciliation. The session cannot execute the local Node regression/build suite because outbound repository network resolution is unavailable, so the same real policy must be retested after deployment before marking the hotfix verified.
